acceptanceCriteria: set-effects and claim emit a warning (not a refusal) naming the key and the suggested directory key when an exact PATH key is a directory in the tree, with a test.
Keys that name files, or directory keys ending in /, produce no warning.
body: Found in RC3 lane C (V1-1090, decision 0493). CAL-V0-021 makes a PATH key without a trailing / exact, so a key naming a directory covers nothing beneath it; submit later refuses OUT_OF_SCOPE (now with the cause named, CAL-V0-024 amendment). set-effects stores keys verbatim and claim reserves them without any warning. V1-1090's first acceptance point expects set-effects to agree with the submit rule. Proposal: a non-refusing warning at set-effects and claim when an exact key names a directory present in the base tree, suggesting the key with /.
title: set-effects and claim should warn when a PATH key without a trailing / names a directory in the tree
